agent: PHASE G AGENT G.9 — REALTIME DOM CHURN UNDER ECHO
scope: Mid-interaction Echo events vs user input/focus/composition across POS (G.9.1), Kiosk wizard (G.9.2), KDS (G.9.3), Cash Overview (G.9.4), focus/scroll preservation patterns (G.9.5)
method: code-static + grep-driven (Playwright MCP not invoked — disk-constrained sub-agent context). Cross-verified vendor library behavior in node_modules/vue-next-select/dist/vue-next-select.es.js. Corroborating empirical evidence from prior cycles cited where applicable.

G_9_1_cashier_customer_search_during_ech.scenario: Cashier types in /admin/pos customer search box; Echo `OrderCreated` arrives mid-keystroke; Q10 Prêt panel re-renders.
G_9_1_cashier_customer_search_during_ech.verdict: GREEN — search input text + focus preserved

evidence.echo_handlers_in_PosComponent: resources/js/components/admin/pos/PosComponent.vue:2637-2696 — `_subscribeEcho` registers OrderCreated → calls `_notifyNewOrder` + `loadKioskCashOrders` + `loadActiveOrdersStats` + `loadReadyOrders`. NONE of these dispatch `user/lists`. The `customers` computed (line 1954) reads `user/lists` Vuex getter — unaffected by Echo.
evidence.Q10_panel_always_render: PosComponent.vue:267-389 — Q10 Prêt à livrer + À encaisser borne panels are ALWAYS rendered (`pos-shortcuts__panel--empty` class only when list empty). Inner `<ul v-if="readyOrders.length > 0">` toggles only the list, not the search box. Per-row `:key="o.id"` (line 291, 355) guarantees in-place patch — list items survive 3-order burst without re-keying.
evidence.search_input_isolation: Customer search uses `vue-select` (vue-next-select 2.10.5) at PosComponent.vue:532-537. Library source verified at node_modules/vue-next-select/dist/vue-next-select.es.js:808 — `searchingInputValue = ref('')` is internal to the component. Library watcher at line 901-909 reacts to `normalized.options` changes (syncs `normalizedModelValue`) but does NOT touch `searchingInputValue`. The `<input>` DOM ref `inputEl` is stable across options-array identity changes (no `:key` change). Conclusion: even if `customers` array reference changed, the search text + focus would persist.
evidence.destroyed_guard: PosComponent.vue:2648/2665/2678 — each Echo handler has `if (this._destroyed) return;` guard (Wave T R1 F2 2026-05-20). No race on unmount.
evidence.audio_beep_no_focus_steal: PosComponent.vue:2914-2939 — `_playNewOrderBeep()` uses WebAudio API (oscillator + gain) — no DOM mutation, no focus capture. `alertService.info` toast renders in portal (vue-toastification) — non-focus-stealing.
evidence.PosOrdersTracker_parity: PosOrdersTrackerComponent.vue:31-44 — native `<input type="search" v-model.trim="filters.query">` is NOT inside any v-if depending on orders. Echo `OrderCreated` → `fetchOrders()` replaces `orders` array, never touches `filters.query`. Search input + focus preserved.
evidence.race_3_orders_2s_window: Each Echo handler triggers parallel store dispatches. `loadKioskCashOrders` / `loadReadyOrders` use `try/catch + finally` reset (lines 2998-3105). No throttle/debounce — but each one replaces the bound array via `this.x = list`. Vue 3 reactivity diffs by `:key` — the only DOM nodes that re-render are the ones whose data actually changed.

findings.title: PosComponent fires 3 parallel store dispatches per OrderCreated (kioskCashOrders + activeOrdersStats + readyOrders)
findings.detail: Each Echo event triggers `loadKioskCashOrders()` + `loadActiveOrdersStats()` + `loadReadyOrders()` (PosComponent.vue:2652-2660). Under a 3-order burst within 2s these multiply to 9 in-flight requests with no debounce. Backend pricing/orders endpoints are cheap (no SSOT recompute on read), so this is not a DoS risk. Net DOM impact = 0 disruption to customer search input (verified above). Worth noting for back-pressure planning if branchCount scales.
findings.remediation: None for V1. If burst load is observed in prod, wrap the three calls in a 200ms debouncer in `_subscribeEcho`.

G_9_2_customer_wizard_during_admin_sauce.scenario: Customer mid-kiosk wizard composing an item; admin toggles a sauce off; Echo `ItemExtraAvailabilityChanged` arrives (bridged to `CatalogChanged` per CatalogChanged.php:88).
G_9_2_customer_wizard_during_admin_sauce.verdict: GREEN with one P2 INFO — wizard composition is immune to mid-session Echo, but in-wizard step invalidation is silent (toast only).

evidence.kiosk_does_NOT_subscribe_to_ItemExtraAva: grep across resources/js — only `StockRuptureDashboardComponent.vue:481` listens to ItemExtraAvailabilityChanged. KioskAppComponent.vue subscribes to ItemAvailabilityChanged + CatalogChanged + ComposerProfileChanged + CouponChanged only (lines 546-575).
evidence.bridge_to_CatalogChanged: ItemExtraAvailabilityChanged is bridged via CatalogChanged outbox row (app/Events/CatalogChanged.php:88-99 — `entityType='item_extra'`). The kiosk DOES receive the CatalogChanged broadcast for sauce-toggle.
evidence.wizard_immune_to_kioskMenu_mutation: KioskWizardComponent.vue:443-445 — `resolvedItem` returns `this.item || this.fetchedItem`. Route config `resources/js/router/modules/kioskRoutes.js:173-181` defines `kiosk.wizard` with `props: true` — passes only route params (`itemId`), not an item Object. Inside the wizard: `fetchedItem` is set ONCE in `fetchItemById()` (line 1690) from a one-shot fetch to `/frontendItem/details`. NO computed or watcher rebinds `fetchedItem` to Vuex `kioskMenu`. grep `this.\$store` in KioskWizardComponent.vue returns only 2 hits (lines 542-543 reading `kioskSettings/customerProfile`) — wizard is decoupled from menu mutations.
evidence.catalog_change_notifier_diff_targets_car: composables/useCatalogChangeNotifier.js:184-280 diffs the `kioskCart/snapshot` (committed lines) against new projection. The wizard's mid-composition `selections` ref is NOT in the snapshot until `Add to cart` is pressed. So when sauce X is toggled off mid-wizard, the customer sees `catalog.menu_refreshed_toast` ('Le menu a été mis à jour') but no targeted feedback. They may still tap the now-disabled sauce option and only discover the rejection at backend submit (422 from PricingService).
evidence.composition_snapshot_NF525_safe: OrderService.php (lines 475, 894, 1358) writes composition_snapshot at create time inside the same DB transaction. NO post-create write path mutates it. For orders already CREATED (e.g., a kiosk order paid 2 minutes before the sauce was 86'd), the live cart UI in another session is irrelevant — the persisted snapshot is bit-frozen. NF525 invariant intact.
evidence.orphan_custom_event: useCatalogChangeNotifier.js:373 dispatches `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('wizard:invalidate-step', { ... }))`. Grep across resources/js finds ZERO `addEventListener('wizard:invalidate-step')` or equivalent. KioskWizardComponent.vue:2238 only listens to `keydown`. The CustomEvent is emitted into the void — in-wizard step highlighting + focus + a11y `announce` (a11y/announcer.js) all fire correctly via the composable, but the wizard component never visually marks the affected step as stale.
evidence.wizard_router_view_key_stability: KioskAppComponent.vue:122-128 wraps `<component>` with `:key="kioskRouterViewKey"`. The key is computed at line 282-290: returns a STABLE constant `kiosk-shell-catalog` on `kiosk.categories` (deliberate per inline comment line 118) and `r.fullPath` elsewhere. Echo events do NOT mutate route or query — the wizard key is stable across CatalogChanged storms. No forced remount.
evidence.toast_visible_focus_neutral: CatalogChangeToastComponent (resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/CatalogChangeToastComponent.vue) is mounted as a sibling of router-view (KioskAppComponent.vue:13-19) — overlay portal, does not steal focus from wizard inputs.

findings.title: Orphan `wizard:invalidate-step` CustomEvent — in-wizard step is never visually invalidated when an extra is removed mid-composition
findings.detail: `composables/useCatalogChangeNotifier.js:373` dispatches `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('wizard:invalidate-step', { detail: { step_ids, removedSelectionsByStep, ... } }))`. The intent per file docstring (line 12-15): 'highlights the affected step in the wizard, focuses it, and announces it via the a11y helper'. The a11y `announce(toastMessage.value, 'polite')` does fire, but the in-wizard visual highlighting + focus does NOT — KioskWizardComponent has no `addEventListener('wizard:invalidate-step')`. Customer mid-composing a sauce that just got 86'd sees only a generic toast 'Le menu a été mis à jour'. They may tap a disabled chip and discover the rejection only at `Add to cart` (PricingService 422). Composition_snapshot NF525 invariant is still intact (frozen at create time).
findings.remediation: Add `mounted() { window.addEventListener('wizard:invalidate-step', this._onCatalogStepInvalidate); }` + matching `beforeUnmount` cleanup in KioskWizardComponent. Inside the handler: highlight affected `:key` step (already keyed via `stepKey()` line 50/80), scroll into view, focus the first invalid chip. The composable already emits the detail payload — only the consumer wiring is missing. Estimated effort: ~20 LOC in the wizard, 0 frozen-zone touches. Defer to V1.0.2 — backend prevents bad orders today.
findings.evidence_path: resources/js/composables/useCatalogChangeNotifier.js:365-381 (dispatch site) vs resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/KioskWizardComponent.vue full file (zero listener registration).

findings.title: kioskMenu/fetchMenu({force:true}) on CatalogChanged is a full menu refetch — bandwidth cost under storm
findings.detail: KioskAppComponent.vue:765-769 dispatches `kioskMenu/fetchMenu({force:true})` on every CatalogChanged event. A burst of 5 admin sauce-toggles (rare but possible during peak rush 86 cycle) triggers 5 full menu refetches per kiosk per branch. No coalescing/debounce on this path. Le Cayenne V1 single-branch + 3-kiosk load profile makes this acceptable; multi-branch SaaS should add a debouncer.
findings.remediation: V1.0.X cloud-prep: add 500ms debounce to `_handleCatalogChanged`. Not a V1 blocker.

G_9_3_chef_kds_bump_during_OrderCreated_.scenario: Chef on /kds clicks Bump on order A; same moment new orders B + C arrive via Echo `OrderCreated`. Verify bump click resolves against order A (not B or C). Verify Vue `:key="order.id"` keeps DOM stable.
G_9_3_chef_kds_bump_during_OrderCreated_.verdict: GREEN — bump action is order-specific via closure capture; KDS card key stability holds

evidence.bump_handler_captures_order_object: KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1776-1788 — `kdsBump(order, item)` is invoked from `@click.prevent.stop="kdsBump(dineinOrder, item)"` (line 425) / `kdsBump(onlineOrder, item)` (line 608) / `kdsBump(takeawayOrder, item)` (line 781) / `kdsBump(kioskOrder, item)` (line 957). Vue v-for binds `order` to the current iteration's object — the click handler closes over that specific reference. Even if the orders array gets replaced 5ms later by `_refreshWithCurrentFilter`, the bump fires against the captured object's `order.id` + `item.id`.
evidence.store_action_keyed_by_id: store/modules/kds.js:55-62 — `bumpItem({orderId, itemId})` writes to `state.bumpedByOrder[orderId]` keyed by stable IDs. No array index involved. The follow-on `orderStatus(order, nextStatus)` call (line 1784) uses `order.id` from the captured closure, not array position.
evidence.vue_for_key_stability: All 4 v-for top-level orders use `:key="order.id"` (lines 282, 479, 649, 827). Vue 3 reconciler patches in-place when ID matches. New orders B + C cause Vue to mount NEW DOM nodes ABOVE/BELOW the existing card for A — but the card for A is preserved (same DOM nodes, same event listeners). The click on A's Bump button is delivered to A's handler with A's order object.
evidence.debounce_300ms_coalesces: _debouncedRefresh (line 2330-2338) coalesces multiple Echo events into ONE refresh after 300ms quiet window. Under B+C arriving within 2s, the chef's click on A fires BEFORE the debounced refresh — even if the refresh later replaces the orders array, the bump store mutation has already been applied. Order A's bumpedItem timestamp persists across refresh because it's in Vuex `kds` module (LocalStorage-persisted via `persistMap`).
evidence.axios_interceptor_no_dom_disturb: Lines 1448-1471 — interceptor fires `_refreshWithCurrentFilter()` on every successful change-status POST. This calls `kitchenDisplaySystemOrder/lists` which replaces the orders array. Same `:key="order.id"` reconciliation applies — chef's other open bump buttons on cards B/C are not disrupted. NO focus to preserve (touch-input UX, no keyboard nav).
evidence.kdsSyncService_throttle: KdsSyncService (services/KdsSyncService.js) has CADENCE_FLOOR_MS=250 hard floor (verified in C1 report). Even under WS storm, polling cannot fire faster than every 250ms.
evidence._destroyed_safe: Echo handler at line 1855-1858 has implicit lifecycle guard via `beforeUnmount` (line 2348) calling `unsubscribeEcho()` — no zombie callback risk.

findings.title: KDS axios response interceptor bypasses 300ms debounce on every successful change-status POST
findings.detail: KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1448-1471 — global axios response interceptor calls `_refreshWithCurrentFilter()` immediately (no debounce) for any POST to `admin/kds-order/change-status/` returning 2xx. Documented as intentional (line 1459-1461: 'Direct refresh ... so the 09-kds-prete window (~1500ms in the spec) catches the transition'). Under rapid chef bumping (3 orders/sec during rush), this generates 3 immediate refresh calls within 1s, each fetching the full orders list. Net effect: no DOM disturbance (Vue reconciles cleanly via stable `:key`), but backend `kitchenDisplaySystemOrder/lists` endpoint sees triple-load. Acceptable for V1 Le Cayenne single-branch; flag for cloud-prep.
findings.remediation: Optionally add a 200ms post-success cool-down per interceptor instance. Not blocking — existing kdsSyncService CADENCE_FLOOR_MS=250 already protects the polling path; this only affects the click→refresh path.

G_9_4_cash_overview_filter_during_OrderC.scenario: Owner on /admin/cash-overview with filter Source=Borne applied; Echo `OrderCreated` fires; verify filter state preserved + F5 URL filter sync (Q8) holds.
G_9_4_cash_overview_filter_during_OrderC.verdict: GREEN — Cash Overview has zero Echo subscription, zero auto-refresh; filter survives unconditionally

evidence.zero_echo_subscription: grep -c 'Echo' on CashOverviewComponent.vue returns 0. No `window.Echo`, no `onEvents` import, no subscribe/unsubscribe. Confirms C6 (presumably an earlier sync chain): 'cash-overview has NO realtime subscription'.
evidence.zero_auto_refresh_timer: grep for setInterval/setTimeout-refresh on the file returns 0 timer registrations beyond `formatTime` (line 257 — pure display formatter). Data loads on form submit only (line 363-422 `submitFilters`).
evidence.filter_state_isolated: CashOverviewComponent.vue:304-310 — filters are local component state. Echo broadcast is processed by the global `window.Echo` connection (services/eventContract.js) and only flows to components that subscribed. With no subscription, the OrderCreated event is silently dropped at the cash-overview surface.
evidence.F5_url_sync_Q8: Lines 332-405 — Wave Z Q8 hydration: filters are read from `$route.query` on mount/`created`. `submitFilters` (line 408-422) calls `$router.push({query: q}).catch(() => {})`. F5 reload re-hydrates filters from URL. Filter survives reload because URL is the source of truth.
evidence.no_v_if_on_filter_form: Filter form (lines 25-235) renders unconditionally — no `v-if` depending on data state. Even if owner is mid-typing a date, the form stays mounted across any background activity.

findings.title: Cash Overview shows stale data if owner doesn't manually re-submit filters
findings.detail: Intentional design (Q8 + decision_pages Wave Polish Final 2026-05-21). Owner must hit `Appliquer` button or change a filter to refetch. New kiosk orders created mid-view do NOT auto-appear. This is the trade-off for stable filter state. Documented in 14/14 owner decisions Q1-Q14.
findings.remediation: None — owner-validated design. If real-time tally desired in V1.0.X, add a 30s manual `Rafraîchir` button (NOT Echo-driven, to keep filter editing stable).

findings.title: PosComponent cart line `:key="\`cart-${index}\`"` is index-based — safe for current UX but fragile to insert-at-top
findings.detail: PosComponent.vue:766 keys cart rows by array index. Today the cart is append-only from cashier action (no Echo writes to cart). If a future feature adds 'insert at top' or sorts the cart, Vue would re-bind index 0 to the new item and force a re-render of every row's input bindings (qty/note). Latent risk, NOT a current bug.
findings.remediation: Add `cart_line_id` (UUID) to cart line objects + key by it. Defer to V1.0.X UI refactor.

verdict: GREEN with 1 P2 INFO and 4 INFO findings
verdict_reasoning: All 5 scenarios verified via code-static analysis + vendor library source reading. Core conclusions: (1) POS customer search is fully insulated from OrderCreated — Echo handlers do not touch user/lists; vue-next-select 2.10.5 keeps searchingInputValue ref independent from options array identity changes. (2) Kiosk wizard mid-composition is technically immune because fetchedItem is a local one-shot snapshot decoupled from Vuex kioskMenu mutations; however, the `wizard:invalidate-step` CustomEvent dispatched by useCatalogChangeNotifier has zero subscribers (P2 INFO) — UX gap where customer is not visually warned about a sauce just 86'd. NF525 invariant safe (composition_snapshot frozen at create). (3) KDS bump captures the order object via closure on @click, debounced 300ms refresh coalesces bursts, stable :key="order.id" reconciles cleanly — no race on the right order. (4) Cash Overview has zero Echo subscription and zero auto-refresh — filter state survives unconditionally; F5 URL sync (Q8) holds. (5) :key audit across PosComponent + KioskApp + KioskWizard + KDS + ItemComponent shows uniformly stable patterns; no full-component remount on Echo events; the kioskRouterViewKey is route-only, not Echo-driven. No P0 / P1 findings. The single P2 (orphan CustomEvent) is a UX polish item — backend prevents bad orders regardless; defer to V1.0.2.
